name_zh: 自然/乌拉圭/牧场/牛肉/羊毛/出口/蒙特维多/帕切科/草原
description_zh: 乌拉圭自然以广阔的牧场和牛羊出口为特色，被誉为"草原上的牛羊王国"。曼努埃尔·帕切科 (Manuel Pacheco) 推动了现代牧场改革，将传统放牧与现代农业技术相结合，使乌拉圭成为世界第二大牛肉出口国和第一大羊毛出口国，被誉为"乌拉圭牧场之父"。
description_en: Uruguay's nature is characterized by vast pastures and beef/wool exports, known as the "Cattle and Sheep Kingdom of the Grassland". Manuel Pacheco promoted modern ranch reform, combining traditional pastoralism with modern agricultural technology, making Uruguay the world's second largest beef exporter and largest wool exporter, known as the "Father of Uruguayan Ranching".
reason_zh: UY-NAT-001 代表了乌拉圭如何通过牧场经济和出口导向，实现农业现代化，以及如何通过改革推动国家发展，体现了拉美牧场经济的典型特征。
reason_en: UY-NAT-001 represents how Uruguay achieves agricultural modernization through ranch economy and export orientation, promotes national development through reform, embodies typical characteristics of Latin American ranch economy.

steps_en: Study Uruguay natural environment/ranch history/export economy
Analyze 19th century ranch development/beef export/wool export
Evaluate ranch economy results/social impact/international evaluation

expected_en: Understand how Latin American achieves agricultural modernization through ranch economy and export orientation, promotes national development through reform, embodies typical characteristics of ranch economy.
case_zh: 19世纪牧场发展；20世纪牛肉出口增长；1950 帕切科牧场改革；1970 乌拉圭成为世界第二大牛肉出口国；1980 成为世界第一大羊毛出口国。牧场经济/出口导向/改革/帕切科/乌拉圭模式永存。
case_en: 19th century ranch development; 20th century beef export growth; 1950 Pacheco's ranch reform; 1970 Uruguay became world's second largest beef exporter; 1980 became world's largest wool exporter. Ranch economy/Export orientation/Reform/Pacheco/Uruguayan model endures.
